paper_title: First results of the CERN Resonant WISP Search (CROWS)
notes: Microwave LSW experiment at CERN constraining both ALPs (g_agamma=4.5e-8 GeV^-1 at 7.2 ueV) and hidden sector photons (chi=4.1e-9 at 10.8 ueV). Reported as DarkPhoton (HSP) result here, which probed previously unexplored parameter space (Fig.14). Only single representative best-sensitivity points are given numerically in the text; full exclusion curves are in Fig.13 (ALP) and Fig.14 (HSP) but not tabulated. CL=95%. Not a haloscope, so no local DM density.
